notes.title: We've just released a new trailer for Good Boy! 👀🤖🐶
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋 Today, we're thrilled to re-announce Good Boy with a brand new trailer!

In Good Boy, you'll play as a dog who's had their consciousness transferred into a Space Rover, in the first of a new heartwarming genre: The Petroidvania.

[previewyoutube=7zQupsvrbto;full][/previewyoutube]
🤖 Key Features of Good Boy

✨ Cosy Creature Collector Petroidvania
We've coined a new name and genre for Good Boy, The Petroidvania. A mix between our Doggo Rover characters and our heartwarming, creature capture metroidvania gameplay!

Take control of a Space Rover and capture and research alien creatures, as you uncover the ancient mysteries of the planet Terra II!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45026378/2ef705caa4908004f33645f08697bdb92d3b44f5.gif

🐶 Play as a Doggo Space Rover
In Good Boy, you'll play as a LAIKA Space Rover. The LAIKA Programme gave old dogs a new lease on life by transferring their consciousness into LAIKA Rovers, allowing them to live on forever as a brave space explorers!

Find and reboot your sleeping canine companions, become best friends, and work together to help The Human with their mission!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45026378/fbe20b405c2ba68724c2012ae4c51b3d65a59762.gif

🪐 Research a familiar, yet alien planet

Use a variety of tools and upgrades to capture the exotic creatures of Terra II. Harness their unique abilities to overcome obstacles and expand the world, or bring them back to Homebase where they can be scanned for Research Credits.

The living, breathing ecosystem of Terra II is at your disposal! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45026378/676c01c771d78671c0e04d9206f9656e0dc15880.gif

💜 Form an unbreakable bond with the Human

When an Anomaly is detected on the remote, alien planet Terra II, a Human explorer is sent out to investigate. After a bumpy landing, the Human's S.O.S beacon awakens a nearby, dormant LAIKA Rover. 

Together, go on a journey to find the Anomaly, and unravel the story behind it's mysterious origin. Form an unbreakable bond, as you work together to complete the Human's mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45026378/9ec1cfcf29db96a25e1901615d11f04d043991d5.gif
Want to keep up to date with Good Boy? Join our Discord server!

🥳 Join today!

notes.title: Good Boy | Meet Alf & Daisy! 👋
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

Today we're back to introduce two new characters to you from Good Boy, our upcoming ecosystem-driven metroidvania!💫

Character Reveals
Meet Alf! 👋

Alf's job is to seek out lost ruins, dig up ancient artefacts, and study the history of Terra II's inhabitants.

🧐 Historian 
🏺 Astro-Archaeologist 
🐾 Hates getting his paws dirty 

Ironically, Alf hates dirt. He uses special grabbers to avoid handling muddy objects with his own paws.

💡 Fun Fact: Alf has an impressive collection of cravats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45026378/3c753f7f79748a403fb3d42815d0858c9fbfb0c5.jpg
Meet Daisy! 👋 

Daisy is a well travelled Rover, she's responsible for capturing images of Terra II's landscape and creatures 🐸


🌍 Location Scout
📷 Photographer
🧠 Loves slinging facts

💡Fun Fact: Daisy is the smallest Rover!

🌼 Yorkshire Born & Bred

notes.title: Good Boy | Observer Interactive & Team17 | Partnership Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

Today, we're thrilled to announce a partnership between Observer Interactive & Team17 for Good Boy! 🚀

In Good Boy, you'll control a LAIKA Space Rover, uncovering ancient mysteries of the planet Terra II in this heart-warming, ecosystem-driven metroidvania!

Watch our Partnership Announcement video below! 👇
[previewyoutube=IVwBo2eiDU8;full][/previewyoutube]
Good Boy - Key Features
🌍 Eco-system Metroidvania: Use a variety of tools and upgrades to capture the exotic creatures of Terra II. Harness their unique abilities to overcome obstacles and expand the world, or bring them back to Homebase where they can be scanned for Research Credits.

❤️ A Human's Best Friend: forge an unbreakable bond with your new Human friend, unravelling the story behind the planet Terra II together!

🐕 LAIKA Rovers: The LAIKA Programme gave old dogs a new lease on life by transferring their consciousness into LAIKA Rovers, allowing them to live on forever as a brave space explorers! Find and reboot your sleeping canine companions, become best friends, and work together to help The Human with their mission.

📈 Rover Upgrades: Make your Rover your own! Upgrade your arsenal with new tools and capturing equipment. Maximise your exploring capabilities with motherboard enhancements and abilities.

❓ Unlock Mysteries: Delve deep into the hidden depths of Terra II! Explore sprawling caves and discover ancient temples, as you uncover the history of the planet and it's previous inhabitants.

🏞️ Explore the beautiful biomes of Terra II: Explore the familiar yet alien planet of Terra II. Utilise your upgrades and creature abilities to adapt to the different biomes!
